pages.title: Shapeless recipe
pages.label: Combine → one result
pages.text: Friendly Slime + any hoe. The original tool and its data are equipped.

Starts waiting. Farm surveys loaded farmland around its current position. Range is twice the common base, initially 16 blocks. Stock seeds or crops in its bag. For new farmland, select Wait, then Farm.

It harvests mature crops, replants from its own bag, and restores registered soil with a hoe. It cannot trample farmland. Full cargo and broken tools request support. See $(l:fieldwork/farmland)Registered plots$().
